481)dbang bsgrub sogs kyi skabs su don la/thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen bstod mjug tu/'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs la bstod:ces kha bsgyu

tei:div.tei:p: 481)dbang bsgrub sogs kyi skabs su don la/ thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen bstod mjug tu/ 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs la bstod: ces kha bsgyur bya/ de man mi dgos/ ༈ rta mgrin bsnyen skabs su/ 'khor sngags rnams nang sgrub ltar du 'gro mi dgos/ shin tu bsdu na dbang chen rtsa sgrub 'don nas/ phur ba'i rtsa sgrub kyi bgegs srung byin mchod rnams sbyar chog pa kun la rigs 'gre/ dpa' bo yab yum gyi sngags mthar/ bum pa bsgrub skabs/ oṃ hrīḥpadma kro ta hya ghṛ wa badzra bha ra hi sarba pañtsa siddhi oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hāḥ btags la bzla/ bsgrub pa'i skabs bsgrub sngags bsdus pa/ oṃ hriḥpadma kro ta hya ghra wa badzra bha ra hi ra tsa hri ya ha ri ṇi sa sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ bzla zhing*/ rigs lnga'i thugs kar gyi 'dzab dor kyang chog ༈ phur pa'i skabs su/ nye bsnyen gyi sngags/ oṃ badzra kī li sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ āḥ'i mthar/ rnam bum 'dzud 482)cing*/ kī la 'bru bcu'i mthar bum sngags btags/ las sbyor skabs spu gri mi dgos/ shin tu bsdu na phur pa'i rtsa sgrub 'don nas/ las sbyor skabs kī la 'bru bcu bzhi bzla/ ༈ mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus kyi las sbyor skabs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsogs/ ra hi ṇi sa'i mthar/ du ru tsa ka sogs/ phaṭaḥ nyer gcig gam bdun re btags/ sngags bsdus yin kyang de gar ro// ༈ mtsho rgyal thugs sgrub kyi sgrub dzab mgor bum pa 'dzud cing*/ rtsa sngags kyi sa ra dza ya'i mtharabum sngags gdags/ bsdu na mtsho rgyal sogs dngos grub bum bzang gis bsgrub kyang chog ḍā brdung tshul ni/ ḍā 'ur lha bskyed 'go nas ḍā dkrol zhing*/ mjug gi shuddhe āḥnas ḍā 'ur chem bzhag thabs/ yang na lha bskyed mjug gi de gar gsal ba'i sogs nas ḍā brdung zhing*/ shudhe āḥnas ḍā 'ur chem bzhag thabs bya/ lus dkyil spyi dril bsnyen pa bsgrub chen la gtogs na las sbyor gong gi bsnyen pa bzla dgos so/

༈ rig byed ma'i las byang bsdu tshul ni/ mtshams sgrub skabs kyi thun gnyis pa phan chad kyi las byang rnams dang*/ dbang yongs rdzogs bsgrub skabs su/ mtshams lha bskyed pa dang*/ bgegs gtor byin rlabs/ bden rjod rnams 'don mi 483)dgos/ bsnyen bstod skabs bstod pa'i/ rig byed dbang mo'i sku gsung thugs la bstod: ces kha bsgyur nas de man chad mi dgos/ ༈ dbang yongs rdzogs bskur skabs/ mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus kyi don dbang 'gor/ lo sgyus las/ chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig sogs/ mdzes pa'i phreng ba gsan par bya la/ dpal mchog dang po sogs/ gzhung ltar ro/ ༈ 'jam dpal/ rdor sems/ khro lod/ mkha' spyod ma/ bde chen dkar mo/ lus dkyil rnams kyi sgo nas rtsa dbang rgyal thabs spyi blugs bskur tshul bsdus pa ni/ sgrub thabs rang rang gi rgyab yig 'don zhing kha bsgyur bya/ maṇḍal phul/ gsol gdab ni/ e ma: gsang sngags bla med sogs/ stsol: tshig mjug lan gsum/ hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i sogs/ bslab par gyis/ sgrub pa rang rang gi skyabs sems lan gsum/ spyi gces kyi dam bzung ngam/ zur bkol gyi dam chu bya/ slob ma lhar bskyed ni/ oṃ ma hā sogs/ bzung ba dang sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs rang gzhung gi lha bskyed mthar/ hūm̐: rang bzhin chos dbyings sogs nas/ tiṣṭha badzra: lha ngo bstan 484)pa ni/ e ma: skal ldan bu rnams sogs/ maṇḍāl hūm̐ḥ bum pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag spros bral sogs/ lha dbang don bsdus su sku tsaka yod pa thams cad 'dir 'dzud/ de nas bhan thod/ thugs srog gi tsitta a bhi khiñtsa hūm̐: rig tsaka ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes rol gar sogs/ shel rdo'i mjug gi a phaṭaḥ sku tsaka gong du song na 'di dor/ ma song tshe/ hūm̐ hrīḥ mtshan dpe rab rdzogs sogs/ gtor ma'i mjug gi ma hā ba lingta a bhi khiñtsa hūm̐: de mthar sgrub pa rang rang gi tshogs mchod mjug gi bkra shis tshigs bcad re brjod do/
gter ston nyid kyi zhal rgyun ltar tshul rdor pas so//
